title: Cluster links
description: The connection between clusters that are measured as pairs: loss and delay in each direction, round trip, traffic, the route and what the throughput tests find. Clusters are shown by cluster id, because cluster names are not in the metrics (the Pairs table names each peer).

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster

query.query: query_result((max by (cluster) (ikhnos_link_peer_info)) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace(max by (cluster) (ikhnos_link_peer_info), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"))

list.definition: query_result((max by (cluster) (ikhnos_link_peer_info)) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace(max by (cluster) (ikhnos_link_peer_info), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"))
list.description: The cluster that measured, by name. The one-way probe, the connect timing and the throughput tests of a pair run from one of its clusters (the one whose id sorts first) and carry that cluster here; the traffic and route series come from both. Choose All to see both.

list.name: peer
list.label: Peer

query.query: query_result((max by (peer) (ikhnos_link_peer_info{cluster=~"$cluster"})) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (peer_name) label_replace(max by (peer) (ikhnos_link_peer_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)"))

list.definition: query_result((max by (peer) (ikhnos_link_peer_info{cluster=~"$cluster"})) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (peer_name) label_replace(max by (peer) (ikhnos_link_peer_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)"))
list.description: The other cluster of the pair, by name, among those the chosen clusters measure.

panels.title: Pairs probed

targets.expr: count(count by (cluster, peer) (ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: Cluster pairs whose one-way probe has reported. The probe runs from one cluster of each pair (the one whose id sorts first), so a pair is counted once. A pair with probing switched off has no probe series and is not counted. Zero (orange) means no probe has reported to FUSION yet: the pair may not be set up or the cluster that runs the probes may send no telemetry here. Sites > Cluster links > Setup lists what each pair still needs.

panels.title: Clusters reporting links

targets.expr: count(count by (cluster) (ikhnos_link_peer_info{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: Clusters that export link series. Every cluster of a measured pair does, because the passive series (traffic, round trip, route) come from both sides.

panels.title: Worst probe loss now

targets.expr: max(ikhnos_link_probe_loss_ratio{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})

panels.description: The highest loss ratio among the latest one-way probe runs, either direction. Amber from 1 %, red from 5 %, as on the Sites screen. Empty (not zero) when no probe has reported: a run that failed withdraws its figures.

panels.title: Probes failing now

targets.expr: count(ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"} == 0) or (0 * count(ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}))

panels.description: Directions whose latest probe run did not complete (probe_up is 0). Zero only when probes are reporting and all completed; empty when no probe reports at all.

panels.title: Throughput tests skipped

targets.expr: sum(increase(ikhnos_link_throughput_tests_skipped_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Tests the scheduler held back in the selected time range (link busy with real traffic, byte budget used up, or the peer's server busy). Skipping is the scheduler doing its job, and a skipped test is tried again later. Empty when no cluster runs throughput tests.

panels.title: Throughput budget used

targets.expr: max(ikhnos_link_throughput_budget_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} / (ikhnos_link_throughput_budget_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} > 0))

panels.description: The most-used cluster-wide byte budget of the throughput tests, as a share of the budget (the budget has no peer, so the Peer selection does not apply). Empty when no cluster has a budget set.

panels.title: Pairs and their cluster ids

targets.expr: (ikhnos_link_peer_info{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace(ikhnos_link_peer_info{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}, "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)")

panels.description: Every pair as each cluster sees it. The panels below show cluster ids, because cluster names are not in the metrics; the peer's display name is here. Both clusters of a pair appear, one row each.

panels.title: Loss and delay: the one-way probe, each direction on its own (forward is cluster to peer)
Probe loss, latest run

targets.expr: (max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_loss_ratio{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_loss_ratio{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Fraction of test packets lost in the most recent run, per direction. A run that failed has no figure, so a gap means no measurement, not no loss. Amber from 1 %, red from 5 %.

panels.title: Probe loss, over the window

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster, peer, direction) (rate(ikhnos_link_probe_packets_lost_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster, peer, direction) (rate(ikhnos_link_probe_packets_sent_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((sum by (cluster, peer, direction) (rate(ikhnos_link_probe_packets_lost_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster, peer, direction) (rate(ikhnos_link_probe_packets_sent_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval]))), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: rate(lost) / rate(sent) of the probe's packet counters: the loss of that direction alone, smoothed over the window instead of one run. Empty while no packets are being sent.

panels.title: Delay variation

targets.expr: (max by (cluster, peer, direction, stat) (ikhnos_link_probe_delay_variation_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((max by (cluster, peer, direction, stat) (ikhnos_link_probe_delay_variation_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: How far the one-way delay rose above its minimum in the latest run (median and max). Valid whether or not the clocks agree, because a constant clock offset cancels out.

panels.title: One-way delay (clocks synchronised)

targets.expr: (max by (cluster, peer, direction, stat) (ikhnos_link_probe_one_way_delay_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((max by (cluster, peer, direction, stat) (ikhnos_link_probe_one_way_delay_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Absolute one-way delay (min, median, max) of the latest run. Shown only when both ends had a synchronised clock; otherwise the figure would include the offset between the clocks, so the series is absent and this panel is empty. Empty is not a fault: run chrony or ntpd on the nodes to get it. The panel to the right says which runs were synchronised.

panels.title: Probe state

targets.expr: ((max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}) + on (cluster, peer, direction) max by (cluster, peer, direction) ((ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"} == 1) and on (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_loss_ratio{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"} >= 0.99))) or max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(((max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}) + on (cluster, peer, direction) max by (cluster, peer, direction) ((ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"} == 1) and on (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_loss_ratio{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"} >= 0.99))) or max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: State of the latest probe run in each direction. Failed: the run did not complete; Probe failures by reason says why (other: the run ended in an error the prober could not name, so read its log; denied: the responder answered and refused the test, usually because something between the clusters rewrites the prober's address). Up: the run completed. Up, all packets lost: the run completed but 99 % or more of the test packets were counted lost. The control connection worked, so the responder is reachable; the test packets did not arrive or were not matched, for example because the UDP test ports are filtered, addresses are rewritten on the way or the clocks are far apart. Gaps are times with no data from that pair.

panels.title: Clocks synchronised

targets.expr: (max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_clock_synchronized{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_clock_synchronized{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Whether both ends had a synchronised clock during the latest run, so the absolute one-way delay can be trusted. Not synchronised is not a fault, it only means the delay figure is withheld.

panels.title: Seconds since the last completed probe

targets.expr: (clamp_max(time() - (max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}) or (0 * max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}))), 86400)) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((clamp_max(time() - (max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}) or (0 * max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_up{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}))), 86400)), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: How stale each direction's probe is. The probe runs about once a minute: amber beyond 5 minutes, red beyond 15. The top of the scale (one day) means the direction has never completed a run, or has not for a day. If the prober itself stops, its series disappear after a few minutes instead and this panel goes empty, so check Probe state and the Delivery health dashboard too.

panels.title: Probe failures by reason

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster, peer, direction, reason) (increase(ikhnos_link_probe_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((sum by (cluster, peer, direction, reason) (increase(ikhnos_link_probe_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Probe runs that could not complete, by reason. timeout: the control connection could not be opened or nothing answered; the probe tool does not say whether the port was refused, the host unreachable or the path silent (TCP connect failures by reason does), so refused and unreachable are rare here. auth: the responder's policy allows the client no mode, for instance an allowFrom list that does not include it. denied: the responder answered and refused the test, usually because something between the clusters rewrites the prober's address (NAT), or its limits were reached. other: a run that ended without a reason the prober could name, so read its log. Only reasons that occurred are drawn, so an empty panel means either no failures or nothing measuring: see Probe state.

defaults.noValue: No probe failures in this range (or no probe is running)

panels.title: Clock error bound

targets.expr: (max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_clock_error_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((max by (cluster, peer, direction) (ikhnos_link_probe_clock_error_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: How far the clocks of the two ends may differ, as the probe tool derived for the latest run. Present only for runs whose clocks were synchronised. Read it beside One-way delay: delay figures smaller than this bound are noise.

defaults.noValue: No synchronised run (run chrony or ntpd on the nodes)

panels.title: Duplicate test packets

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster, peer, direction) (increase(ikhnos_link_probe_packets_duplicated_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((sum by (cluster, peer, direction) (increase(ikhnos_link_probe_packets_duplicated_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Probe packets that arrived more than once. A steady trickle points at a path that duplicates packets (a misconfigured bond or mirror), not at loss. Only intervals with duplicates are drawn.

defaults.noValue: No duplicates in this range (or no probe is running)

panels.title: Round trip: TCP connect timing (from one cluster of each pair) and the round trip of real connections (both)
TCP connect time, mean

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval]))), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Mean time to open a TCP connection to the peer's responder, SYN to established: a round trip as the TCP stack sees it, sampled every few seconds on an idle link. The same figure the Sites screen shows. This is the idle round trip to compare the loaded one with.

panels.title: TCP connect time, p50 / p95 / p99

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (cluster, peer, le) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (cluster, peer, le) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, peer, le) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, peer, le) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, peer, le) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, peer, le) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Percentiles of the connect time, estimated from the histogram's buckets (0.5 ms to 2.5 s), so they are exact only to the bucket width. The p99 of a quiet window rests on few samples.

panels.title: Round trip of real connections, p50 / p95

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (cluster, peer, le) (rate(ikhnos_link_rtt_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (cluster, peer, le) (rate(ikhnos_link_rtt_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, peer, le) (rate(ikhnos_link_rtt_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, peer, le) (rate(ikhnos_link_rtt_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Smoothed TCP round trip of connections applications actually have with the peer, as the kernel measured it. Both clusters of a pair report their own connections, so a pair has two lines here, one per measuring cluster, and an idle link has none.

panels.title: TCP connect failure ratio

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])))), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Share of connect rounds in which no address of the peer answered. A round where a later address answered counts as a success. Amber from 1 %, red from 5 %. Empty while no rounds are being timed.

panels.title: TCP connect failures by reason

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster, peer, reason) (increase(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((sum by (cluster, peer, reason) (increase(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Connect rounds that failed, by the last attempt's reason. refused means the host is up and the responder is not; timeout means the host or the path is down. Only reasons that occurred are drawn.

defaults.noValue: No connect failures in this range (or connect timing is off)

panels.description: Fraction of datagrams lost at the highest clean rate (clean) and at the first rate over the threshold (first_loss, absent if the ramp never exceeded it).

panels.title: Round trip under load and idle

targets.expr: (max by (cluster, peer, direction, streams) (ikhnos_link_throughput_rtt_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer", protocol="tcp", dscp="0"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((max by (cluster, peer, direction, streams) (ikhnos_link_throughput_rtt_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer", protocol="tcp", dscp="0"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

(sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster, peer) (rate(ikhnos_link_tcp_connect_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__rate_interval]))), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Mean TCP round trip during the latest test (only for the direction the testing cluster sends in), next to the idle connect time. The difference is queueing delay on the link (bufferbloat).

panels.title: Throughput byte budget

targets.expr: (max by (cluster) (ikhnos_link_throughput_budget_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((max by (cluster) (ikhnos_link_throughput_budget_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)")

(max by (cluster) (ikhnos_link_throughput_budget_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((max by (cluster) (ikhnos_link_throughput_budget_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)")

(max by (cluster, peer) (ikhnos_link_throughput_pair_budget_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((max by (cluster, peer) (ikhnos_link_throughput_pair_budget_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

(max by (cluster, peer) (ikhnos_link_throughput_pair_budget_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((max by (cluster, peer) (ikhnos_link_throughput_pair_budget_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Bytes the tests carried in the budget window against the budget: for all peers together (no Peer filter) and for a pair with a budget of its own. A budget of 0 means none. When used reaches the budget, tests wait and show as skipped.

panels.title: Throughput tests skipped, by reason

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster, peer, reason) (increase(ikhnos_link_throughput_tests_skipped_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__range])) > 0) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((sum by (cluster, peer, reason) (increase(ikhnos_link_throughput_tests_skipped_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__range])) > 0), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Tests held back in the whole selected time range, by pair and reason: link_busy (real traffic on the link), budget (used up) or server_busy (the peer's server was serving another test). A skipped test is tried again later. Counted over the range, not per interval, because tests are hours apart.

defaults.noValue: No tests skipped in this range (or no throughput tests are configured)

panels.title: Throughput tests failed, by reason

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster, peer, reason) (increase(ikhnos_link_throughput_test_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__range])) > 0) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((sum by (cluster, peer, reason) (increase(ikhnos_link_throughput_test_failures_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[$__range])) > 0), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Tests that could not be run or finished in the whole selected time range, by pair and reason (unreachable, refused, timeout, auth, other). auth means the iperf3 credentials differ between the clusters. Counted over the range, not per interval, because tests are hours apart; a counter that first appears with a failure already in it shows nothing until the next one.

defaults.noValue: No test failures in this range (or no throughput tests are configured)

panels.title: Bytes the tests put on the link, per hour

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster, peer, direction) (increase(ikhnos_link_throughput_test_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[1h]))) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((sum by (cluster, peer, direction) (increase(ikhnos_link_throughput_test_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"}[1h]))), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: What the throughput tests cost: bytes they carried in each direction, per hour. Tests are rare, so this is spikes.

panels.title: Seconds since the last throughput test

targets.expr: (time() - max by (cluster, peer) (ikhnos_link_throughput_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((time() - max by (cluster, peer) (ikhnos_link_throughput_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: How long ago a test with the peer last finished. The interval between tests is set per pair, from 10 minutes to 7 days, so a long time is normal when the interval is long. Empty when no test has finished since the prober started.

panels.title: UDP: rate at the two ramp points

targets.expr: (max by (cluster, peer, direction, dscp, point) (ikhnos_link_throughput_udp_point_bits_per_second{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((max by (cluster, peer, direction, dscp, point) (ikhnos_link_throughput_udp_point_bits_per_second{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: The rates of the two points of the latest UDP ramp that the loss and jitter panels are read at: clean is the highest rate within the loss threshold, first_loss the first rate over it (absent if the ramp never exceeded it).

panels.title: UDP: jitter at the two ramp points

targets.expr: (max by (cluster, peer, direction, dscp, point) (ikhnos_link_throughput_udp_jitter_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})) * on (cluster) group_left (cluster_name) topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info) * on (peer) group_left (peer_name) label_replace(label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "peer", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "cluster_name", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name, peer_name) label_replace(label_replace((max by (cluster, peer, direction, dscp, point) (ikhnos_link_throughput_udp_jitter_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", peer=~"$peer"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)"), "peer_name", "$1", "peer", "(.+)")

panels.description: Receiver jitter at the clean point and at the first rate over the loss threshold. Jitter that climbs sharply between the two is a queue filling up.
